tagline: A cat, a home, anywhere in the world.
hello: Hello! I'm Pat, the maker's own cat. I show new cats around.
Every cat here lives somewhere real. Let me show you a few.

stops.line: Biscuit's terrace is in London. It rains, so she has the windowsill.
Up in the Alps, Juniper's cabin is snowed in half the year. She approves.
Nata lives on a rooftop by the sea in Lisbon and spends all day watching the gulls.
Bram lives on a houseboat on an Amsterdam canal. He has never once got wet.
In the Cotswolds it's blossom season. Clover follows it round the garden.
Mango watches the sun go down from a balcony in Bali. Then: zoomies.
Saffron's flat in Marrakech stays warm all night. No fur needed.

outro: Every one of them started with a cat. Let's make yours.
builder: Who's moving in? Every look is free. Start from a cat you like and change anything.
map: Your home's sky, seasons and weather will follow the place you choose.
homes: Each home is painted for where you live.

room.text: This is your living room. {cat} has just moved in.
Here's the idea: care for {cat} every day to win their trust, and make this home yours.
First things first: breakfast. Tap Feed.
Now say hello. Tap {cat} for a stroke.
Let's make it yours. Tap Decorate.
Tap a piece to bring it in, then drag it where you like.
Lovely. Tap Done when it looks right.
Play has three games. Five plays a day pay Beans.
The moon starts a twenty-minute nap, on your Lock Screen too.
Your rooms, the book of {cat}'s presents and the map of your home: all in the menu.
The shop has sets, outfits and Cat Club. Nothing in it is needed to play.
Everything you do earns XP. Each new level opens another room of the house.
Your next goals are always up here. Each one pays Beans and XP, and leads to the next.
Welcome home! Here are some Beans to get you started.
